data.long_description:
Spacious 1-bedroom apartment in Hills Park, a contemporary residential development by Emaar within the prestigious Dubai Hills Estate. Designed to embrace greenery and modern living, this residence offers refined interiors, premium amenities, and a tranquil community atmosphere—ideal for professionals and individuals seeking balance between urban convenience and nature.

Property Features:
1 Bedroom
Open-plan living and dining area
Balcony with pool view
Bright interiors with floor-to-ceiling windows
High-quality finishes throughout

Community Amenities – Hills Park:
Swimming pool and children’s pool
Fully equipped gymnasium
Outdoor fitness, yoga, and meditation zones
BBQ and picnic areas
Children’s playgrounds
Sports courts
24/7 security and concierge services

Location Highlights:
Direct access to Dubai Hills Park
2-minute drive to Dubai Hills Mall
5 minutes to GEMS International School
7 minutes to King’s College Hospital
15 minutes to Downtown Dubai
20 minutes to Dubai International Airport
